subject: Error bars or confidence interval on a density plot

messages.author: 87cf4991b6a810ee
messages.subject: Error bars or confidence interval on a density plot
parts: I have a density plot over which I would like to render a confidence interval using horizontal error bars. Is this possible or do I need to use a shaded box?

messages.author: f4249b01b99d0091
messages.subject: Re: Error bars or confidence interval on a density plot
parts:
Hmm, I guess I'd precompute -- use R's density() function first on the
data, add data for error bars, and then plot it all use geom_line and
geom_errorbar.

If you can provide a reproducible example, that will help people give
more specific advice.

Ben
